android.desc:
Codala: The Social World of Barcodes & QR Codes

Every barcode has a story; every QR code hides a conversation. Transform the physical world into a digital chat room with Codala!

Codala is an innovative social media app that allows you to join specific chat rooms for any product, place, or object simply by scanning its barcode or QR code. Whether it’s a grocery item, a restaurant menu, or the barcode on the back of a book you’re reading—instantly step into that code's world.

Key Features:

Scan & Discover: Open your camera and scan any barcode or QR code you see. Instantly teleport into a custom chat room created specifically for that code.

Chat Rooms: Once inside, read reviews from others who scanned the same item, share your own thoughts, and become part of the community.

Create a Room: Is there no room for the barcode you scanned yet? Great! Be the first explorer, create the room, and start the conversation.

Direct Messaging: Connect with people you meet in the rooms, make new friends, and enjoy one-on-one conversations with the private messaging feature.

Where Can You Use Codala?

Restaurants & Cafes: Scan the QR code on the menu or the barcode on your receipt to see real user reviews and meet others currently at the venue.

Grocery Products: Scan the barcode of chocolates, drinks, or household items to see what others think about them.

Books & Magazines: Scan a book's barcode to discuss theories and plot twists with other readers.

Event Tickets & Posters: Scan QR codes on concert or event posters to meet other attendees beforehand.

Every code on Earth opens the door to a new conversation. Download Codala now and become part of this hidden social network!

quotes.text:
Hi HN. I poured months into making a mobile app called Codala, but sadly, it's getting practically zero downloads. I have no marketing budget at all.

I'm starting to question if the app is just bad, but the core idea feels solid to me: you scan any QR code or barcode, and it opens up a space to chat, leave reviews, and discuss that specific product or place.

I know the app needs users leaving comments to feel alive, but it's been 3 weeks and things are dead quiet. If you want to take a look, I’m totally open to any feedback or honesty.

It's only available on Google Play for now
